title: Probabilistic Race and Ethnicity Prediction Using Group-Specific Name Lists
reasoning: The paper includes a dedicated empirical validation section (Section 5.3) on predicting religious sect affiliations (e.g., Shia, Sunni, Maronite, Druze) in Lebanon using LLM-generated name lists, which involves evaluating the capability of LLMs and NLP systems to represent and identify religious groups.
